items.title: Smelloff ODORSTRIKE Fabric Odor Eliminator Spray (50ml)
items.description: Smelloff ODORSTRIKE is a fabric-only odor-control mist designed to reduce unwanted odor in clothing. It contains a light fragrance that provides a subtle fresh scent immediately after spraying, but the fragrance is not the product's primary purpose. The scent fades quickly while the odor-control benefit is intended to remain.
